concerns.text: Tasks T024a and T024b (calculating Pearson correlation and documenting electrode collinearity) are marked as incomplete/unverified. These tasks are prerequisites for T029 (FWE correction) which explicitly requires reading the output of T024a/b. The missing implementation of T024a/b means the FWE correction (FR-009) cannot be executed, leaving a critical spec requirement uncovered.

Task T001e_config is marked incomplete. It is responsible for creating `config.py` with the `BENCHMARK_ACCURACY` key. Task T032 (Phase 5) depends on this key to perform the benchmark pass/fail check (SC-002). Without T001e_config, the benchmark validation logic has no input, leaving SC-002 unimplemented.

Task T036b (Optimize epoch loading to meet <6h runtime) is marked incomplete. The Plan (Phase 3 Step 6) and Spec (US-1 Independent Test) explicitly require the pipeline to run within the allocated CI time budget (6 hours). Without T036b, there is no task ensuring the temporal constraint is met, leaving a critical plan element uncovered.

Tasks T050 (End-to-end integration), T051 (Verify T044 completion), and T053 (Validate total execution time) are marked incomplete. These tasks are essential for the 'Final Integration & Verification' phase described in the Plan. Their absence means the feature cannot be verified as end-to-end functional on the target CI runner, leaving the Plan's final phase uncovered.

Task T001e_config defines `BENCHMARK_ACCURACY` as the string literal `'targetThreshold'`. This is a placeholder that does not satisfy the requirement for a numeric benchmark value (65%) defined in Constitution Principle VII and SC-002. The task description fails to specify how this placeholder is replaced with the actual numeric value required for T032 to function.
